reviewType: Independent read-only visual inspection of downloaded official CI PNGs

method.note: Every file in actualViewedFiles was displayed and visually inspected. A previous oversized image batch was not treated as sufficient inspection; those individual sprites were re-opened in small batches.

verification.sourceBinding: Both C1 manifests name the candidate head. git show confirms candidate and ef9efc5292584aa62e15e5a7f899946fb753d1d0 have byte-identical index.html and art file, with hashes above. This does not rebind uninspected C2 artifacts to C1 automatically.

outcome.status: No definite new wave16 sprite/art defect observed; construction evidence and occluded geometry limitations remain.

geometryFindings.observed: All four rotations retain a low square stone hall with curved arched ends and a crosswise roof junction. The center is visually filled with slate/shaded roof pixels; no exposed background hole or detached strip was seen in sprites, near-r0, or edge-r0..3.
geometryFindings.limit: At native scale the shallow vault relief is subtle. PNG inspection establishes rendered continuity, not the mathematical topology of the two barrel surfaces.

geometryFindings.observed: The roof reads as one continuous ribbed tapering form, with a raised rounded fan-window front and a lower straight rear. It remains an enclosed brick hall rather than an open shelter in all four rotations.

Rounded four-lobe perimeter and central low square lantern remain continuous in all four rotations. The recessed joins and lantern base show no obvious background cracks, detached lobes, open courtyard, or tall-octagon substitution.
Two broad polygonal ends join through a visibly narrow solid waist; the overall bow-tie outline remains legible in all rotations without a visible courtyard or free-standing pavilion gap.
Stone body and vertical ribs remain continuous from broad footing to modest upper ring and single shallow cap. No floating oversized head, staircase tower, or double-cap substitution is apparent.
The unequal rounded ends, single concave entry edge, continuous low roof, and offset rectangular sound-room element remain visible across rotations; no internal courtyard is apparent.
Broad upper workshop, central lower brick spine, and open lower flanks are visible. Small support details connect toward the underside where exposed. No obvious new detached pixel strip was seen.
geometryFindings.limit: The pale diagonal supports are small and low contrast at native scale; hidden support topology is not established by these static PNGs.

geometryFindings.observed: Three stepped-back polygonal levels and broad continuous eaves remain legible across all rotations. It does not read as a stack of square boxes or an open courtyard.

Rectangular upper half-timber workshop over the beveled/octagonal stone lower body is legible. The upper-floor fascia/underside appears contiguous with the lower structure; no visible horizontal background slit or floating upper floor was found in sprites, near view, or four edge rotations.
geometryFindings.limit: Tiny bracket attachments on rear faces are occluded; the review does not claim inspection through the building.

geometryFindings.observed: Perpendicular unequal gabled rooms and an open external wedge are clear in r1/r3. Bowed glass corridor and its visible joins appear continuous in r1/r3. A narrow connector segment is visible in r2. No obvious exposed detached endpoint was found.
geometryFindings.limit: r0 hides essentially the entire corridor behind the rooms/roofs, and r2 strongly occludes the endpoints. Both endpoint joins are not independently visually proven in every rotation. near-harecase.png is r0 and cannot resolve that occlusion.

sceneFindings.detail: All 80 individual 160x196 day/night sprite files were directly viewed. No obvious hard edge crop or stray large patch was seen. The isolated night overlays visually follow window/lamp features; the black display background is not evidence that the whole night sprite is opaque. No exhaustive numeric alpha mask audit was performed.

All 40 full season/day/night/rotation combinations were viewed. All ten mature buildings appear in the row across spring, summer, autumn, winter-bare, and winter-snow. Snow/ice effects, terrain, and night overlays remain present. No new obvious missing mature building or broken roof boundary was seen.

All ten near frames and forty individual edge frames were inspected. Main subjects are present at the map boundary in every orientation; no hard clipping of the main building was seen. Neighboring subjects may naturally leave the viewport in near frames.

The eight preview native camera frames crop the outer ends of the ten-building row, including parts of Linden/Hare. They are not full-row completeness evidence. The separate forty seasonal scene frames show the whole row.

Tall blue upward light columns are visible in night scenes. Source-only git comparison confirms SPOT_K359 whitelist, T359 spotlight sprite-generation block, and T359 renderer block are identical between base and candidate. The whitelist includes k24 and the renderer intentionally emits upward landmark beams. These are not classified as a new wave16 art defect. The supplied legacy lighthouse scenes do not exercise the same row setup.
far-day.png and far-night.png show simplified ground footprints/points instead of full workshop architecture. They demonstrate a far-view scene, not detailed architectural readability at far zoom.

hover-meadowsweetherb.png shows translucent Meadowsweet and adjacent Sorrel with visible ground/selection overlay. No obvious torn silhouette was seen. The normal row scenes place buildings apart; these images do not establish dynamic pedestrian/vehicle/building overlap, hover hit-testing, or a dense overlap scenario.
rain-night.png retains the ten building forms, window lights, terrain, and existing spotlight effect. Static rain evidence cannot prove animation timing or interaction.

C1 construction-early shows ten foundation plots. C1 construction-middle shows scaffolded intermediate structures for Linden, Wren, and Meadowsweet while seven remain foundations. C1 construction-late shows scaffolded forms for the first nine, while Hare remains a foundation. C2 construction-late shows scaffolded forms for the first seven, while Sain, Bracken, and Hare remain foundations. Therefore these captures do not prove every building at every construction stage, and the C1/C2 late captures are not visually equivalent. Source-only inspection identifies the existing X13 cold-profile queue and pending-placeholder path as a mechanism consistent with these partially settled captures. This is source diagnosis, not a browser verification that these particular captures reached or failed a settlement condition.
sceneFindings.requiredFollowup: Construction coverage remains pending additional authorized official CI evidence. Preserve both originals; compare naturally settled captures and separately labeled native-flush diagnostics rather than calling the original late captures equivalent.

sourceDiagnosis.profile: index.html:111415-111430: cold budgeted profiles queue in PQ and return 'pending'; idle draining uses 8 ms, with a flush helper present.
sourceDiagnosis.site: index.html:111625-111631: site() calls profile and draws pending(A) while pending.
sourceDiagnosis.placeholder: index.html:111749-111755: pending(A) draws a soil-colored lot and fence.
sourceDiagnosis.verification: The source mechanism was read, not executed. Additional official CI natural-settlement and explicitly labeled native-flush diagnostic evidence is being prepared by the parent and has not yet been reviewed here.
sourceDiagnosis.fallback: index.html:111614 drains at most a 3 ms budget after three consecutive frame waits. The profile, idle-scheduler, and pending-renderer source excerpts are unchanged from the base commit.

sceneFindings.detail: All sixteen base/head legacy PNGs were viewed, and each of the eight base/head pairs has identical SHA-256. This supports unchanged pixels for those supplied lighthouse baseline scenes only, not every legacy asset.

limitations: Author/reviewer PNG inspection is not owner approval, final acceptance, gameplay validation, or release authorization.
No browser, game, local smoke/probe, or other local test was executed. Existing PNGs were not re-rendered, resized, cropped, edited, or replaced.
No actual phone, Safari, touchscreen, real device FPS, or hardware behavior was tested.
Static images do not prove hidden geometry, dynamic depth/overlap, save/load behavior, navigation, timing, or interaction.

Construction completeness differs between captures despite equal index/art source bytes. Existing source contains an asynchronous cold-profile queue and pending-placeholder renderer consistent with that difference, but settlement in these specific captures is not browser-verified here.
All C1 PNGs were inspected. Only the one explicitly listed additional C2 construction PNG was directly inspected as C2 evidence.
publicationNote: Review of original CI images; artifact IDs and producer run explicitly identified. No owner approval.
